observations.detail: Video starts with a pulsing pulsar graphic and clear single-word bold captions.
Smooth transitions and whip pans match the cosmic science theme.
Captions clearly display each word in synchronization with the spoken narration.
Maintains high energy voiceover matching the dramatic script.
Consistent text styling, high contrast yellow text with black stroke is highly readable.
Strong coherent payoff at the end of the short documentary.

summary: English short documentary video with excellent subtitle synchronization, clear visuals, and high-energy narration.
